nodes.label: piSignage Arbitrary File Download via Path Traversal
nodes.precondition: Attacker possesses network connectivity to piSignage instance and authenticated low-privilege user credentials.
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary file read on underlying Raspberry Pi OS, exposing sensitive configuration files, credentials, and system data.

nodes.label: RaspAP Web Console Command Execution
nodes.precondition: Attacker possesses authenticated access to the RaspAP web interface on the Raspberry Pi.
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary command execution, file upload, and underlying operating system code execution on Raspberry Pi OS.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Default Credential Authentication
nodes.precondition: Network or local access to Raspberry Pi OS (<= 5.10) with unmodified default credentials ('pi':'raspberry').
nodes.postcondition: Authenticated shell access with administrative (sudo) privileges on the Raspberry Pi OS.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Glowworm Acoustic Side-Channel Attack
nodes.precondition: Raspberry Pi 3 B+ or 4 B powering connected audio speakers; optical line-of-sight to the power indicator LED within range of electro-optical sensors and telescope.
nodes.postcondition: Unauthorized eavesdropping and reconstruction of analog acoustic and speech signals played by connected speakers.

nodes.label: Oculus Browser UI Injection and Code Execution
nodes.precondition: Victim navigates to an attacker-controlled remote web page using Oculus Browser (versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11).
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary HTML injection into browser UI, enabling interface spoofing and unprivileged arbitrary code execution in the local user context.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Arbitrary File Write Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Local unprivileged access on Windows running Oculus Desktop prior to version 1.44.0.32849.
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary file write via hard link manipulation during privileged log file operations, leading to SYSTEM-level local privilege escalation.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher.exe Handle Leak Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Local unprivileged access on Windows running Oculus Desktop (versions 1.39 through 31.1.0.67.507).
nodes.postcondition: Exposure of privileged process handles to unprivileged processes, leading to local privilege escalation to SYSTEM authority.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU Configuration Error Hardware DMA Access
nodes.precondition: Attacker with physical access to the Jetson carrier board capable of interfacing directly with the PCI bus.
nodes.postcondition: Direct read and write access to the complete system physical address space, resulting in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, denial of service, and full confidentiality/integrity compromise.

edges.label: Extracted configuration or application credentials from path traversal enable authenticated access to RaspAP web interface.
Exfiltrated /etc/shadow or configuration hashes allow cracking or recovering the default 'pi' system password.
Administrative system access facilitates retrieval or manipulation of RaspAP web administrative credentials.
Code execution obtained via browser exploitation provides the local unprivileged context required to create hard links targeting OVRRedir.exe.
Code execution obtained via browser exploitation provides the local unprivileged process to capture leaked handles from OVRServiceLauncher.exe.
